description: ShelfMate: a reading tracker where seven features work; the CSV export and the reading goal's progress bar do not do what they promise.

claims.text: Create an account with an email and a password
Add a book with a title and an author
See your books and search them by title or author
Edit a book's details or delete it
Mark a book as Want to read, Reading or Finished and its badge changes
Rate finished books from 1 to 5 and see the average rating
Export the shelf as a CSV file
Set a yearly reading goal and a progress bar shows how many books are finished
